response.overview: Ornette Coleman Trio / Sound??? is a 2004 DVD pairing two mid-1960s free jazz documentaries onto one disc. Side one — "Ornette Coleman Trio" (also known as David, Moffett, and Ornette: The Ornette Coleman Trio): Directed by English filmmaker Dick Fontaine, this documentary was filmed in Paris in the spring of 1966, capturing Ornette Coleman recording the soundtrack for a Living Theatre project called Who's Crazy?  Side two — "Sound???": This features Roland Kirk on reeds and John Cage as performer — a separate short documentary/performance piece, distinct from the Coleman film but sharing the era's free-jazz/avant-garde documentary sensibility
response.title: Ornette Coleman Trio / Sound???
